1 // bin/deliverable.mjs — Wave 10: Deliverable assembly and rendering (Wave 10 changes recovered)+ HONEST DEGRADED MODE (Phase E).
2 //
3 // MASTER-PLAN Phase E / IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 10 done-when: assemble the run's final deliverable so
4 // it CARRIES — as first-class, separable sections —
5 //   • the ROUND HISTORY (the Wave-7 multi-round adversarial loop, per-round),
6 //   • the JUDGE VERDICT (G4, the separate context-free decider),
7 //   • the CONVERGENCE PROOF (the Wave-7 honest convergence tracker's final state + per-round trail),
8 //   • ρ̂ + the LEARNED-QUORUM STATE (the Wave-9 calibration verdict — carried in BOTH modes because
9 //     default-mode calibration is a pure function of inputs), and
10 //   • the separate SYNTHESIZER BRIEF (the active Deep-Think steer — kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the
11 //     Judge verdict: the Synthesizer steers, it never decides — premortem #6 / crit-6).
12 //
13 // And it makes the DEGRADED (non-engine / prose) mode HONEST:
14 //   • a non-engine run emits the literal HONESTY STAMP ("schema conforms; adversarial verification did
15 //     NOT run") and force-sets `cross_model:false` (I3 — degraded mode is never an independence claim);
16 //   • the user-facing prose surfaces (the three researchPrime summary levels) of a prose-mode
17 //     deliverable NEVER claim "parity" with an engine-verified result — the output-conformance gate
18 //     (test/output-conformance.test.mjs) forbids the literal word in every prose-mode surface.
19 //
20 // REUSE, NOT FORK: this module ASSEMBLES already-produced outputs (round.mjs's `orchestrateRound`
21 // results, its `makeConvergenceTracker` state, and rho-ledger.mjs's `calibrationVerdict`) into the
22 // deliverable shape + renders the user surfaces. It computes no verification of its own and re-homes no
23 // gate logic; it is the presentation seam on top of Waves 6–9. `MODES` is the SAME two-mode taxonomy the
24 // evidenced core (verify-core.mjs) already locks, imported not re-declared.
25 //
26 // PURITY: every function here is a deterministic, side-effect-free function of its inputs — no clock, no
27 // randomness, no I/O. The deliverable is a value; rendering it is a pure projection of that value.
28 
29 import { MODES } from './verify-core.mjs';
30 // HALT-for-human signalling — the single upstream class, via the canonical trio-core specifier (no fork).
31 import { HaltError } from '#trio-core/contract-core.mjs';
32 
33 /**
34  * The literal honesty stamp a NON-ENGINE (prose/degraded) run wears (done-when). Asserted verbatim by
35  * the output-conformance gate — a host that cannot run the adversarial loop says so in exactly these
36  * words, never silently presenting prose as if it were verified.
37  */
38 export const HONESTY_STAMP = 'schema conforms; adversarial verification did NOT run';
39 
40 /** researchPrime's three deliverable summary levels — the user-facing surfaces (the prose check's scope). */
41 export const SUMMARY_LEVELS = Object.freeze(['full', 'executive', 'agent-implementation']);
42 
43 /**
44  * The word FORBIDDEN in any prose-mode (non-engine) user surface (done-when). A degraded run must not
45  * imply it is on par / "parity" with an engine-verified result — the honesty stamp already says
46  * verification did not run, and no surface may walk that back.
47  */
48 export const FORBIDDEN_PROSE_WORD = 'parity';
49 
50 // ── cross_model (I3): a heterogeneity proxy, true ONLY in the engine across attested distinct lineages ──
51 /**
52  * `cross_model` is TRUE only in ENGINE mode AND when the run actually spanned ≥2 distinct substrate
53  * families (a heterogeneity PROXY, never an independence guarantee — I3). DEGRADED mode forces it FALSE
54  * unconditionally: a host that did not run the adversarial loop cannot claim cross-model anything.
55  */
56 export function crossModelFor(mode, substrateFamilies = []) {
57   if (mode !== 'engine') return false; // I3: degraded ⇒ cross_model:false, always
58   const fams = new Set(
59     (Array.isArray(substrateFamilies) ? substrateFamilies : [])
60       .filter((f) => typeof f === 'string' && f.trim().length > 0)
61       .map((f) => f.trim()),
62   );
63   return fams.size >= 2;
64 }
65 
66 // ── ROUND HISTORY — the per-round trail of the Wave-7 loop ───────────────────────────────────────────
67 /**
68  * Project the raw `orchestrateRound` results into a compact, auditable round-history trail: one record
69  * per round naming what that round did (dry/empty, finding count, the GATE-1 origin quorum, conflicts,
70  * whether G9 debate fired). This is the deliverable's "round history" section.
71  */
72 export function deriveRoundHistory(rounds = []) {
73   if (!Array.isArray(rounds)) throw new HaltError('deriveRoundHistory requires a rounds[] array');
74   return rounds.map((r, i) => ({
75     round: Number.isInteger(r?.round) ? r.round : i + 1,
76     dry: !!r?.dry,
77     empty: !!r?.empty,
78     findings: Array.isArray(r?.tally?.findings) ? r.tally.findings.length : 0,
79     quorum: r?.quorum
80       ? { origins: r.quorum.origins ?? 0, required: r.quorum.required ?? null, met: !!r.quorum.met }
81       : null,
82     conflicts: Array.isArray(r?.conflicts) ? r.conflicts.length : 0,
83     debate_fired: !!r?.debate?.fired,
84   }));
85 }
86 
87 // ── SYNTHESIZER BRIEF — the steer, kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the Judge verdict ─────────────────────
88 /**
89  * Build the Synthesizer Brief from the per-round `direction` outputs. It is a SEPARATE section
90  * (premortem #6 / crit-6: the Synthesizer steers, it never decides) and is stamped `decides:false` so
91  * the conformance gate can assert it is never conflated with the Judge's verdict (G4 decides).
92  */
93 export function buildSynthesizerBrief(rounds = []) {
94   if (!Array.isArray(rounds)) throw new HaltError('buildSynthesizerBrief requires a rounds[] array');
95   const perRound = rounds
96     .map((r, i) => ({ round: Number.isInteger(r?.round) ? r.round : i + 1, direction: r?.direction ?? null }))
97     .filter((x) => x.direction != null);
98   return {
99     role: 'synthesizer',
100     decides: false, // crit-6: STEERS, never decides — the separate Judge (G4) decides.
101     note: 'STEERING ONLY — the Synthesizer steers; the separate context-free Judge (G4) decides.',
102     rounds: perRound,
103   };
104 }
105 
106 // ── The DELIVERABLE assembler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
107 /**
108  * Assemble the run's final deliverable VALUE.
109  *
110  * ENGINE mode: the full adversarially-verified deliverable — round history, the final round's Judge
111  * verdict, the convergence proof, the calibration (ρ̂ + learned-quorum) state, and the separate
112  * Synthesizer Brief. `cross_model` reflects the actual substrate.
113  *
114  * DEGRADED / non-engine mode: the adversarial loop did NOT run on this host, so the verification-only
115  * sections are NULL and the deliverable carries the literal HONESTY STAMP with `cross_model:false`
116  * (I3). The calibration state is still carried (default-mode ρ̂/learned-quorum is a pure function of
117  * inputs), so the deliverable never has to fabricate or omit it.
118  *
119  * @param {object} o
120  * @param {'engine'|'degraded'} o.mode
121  * @param {Array<object>} [o.rounds]              raw orchestrateRound results (round history source)
122  * @param {?object}       [o.convergence]         the convergence tracker's final state (the proof)
123  * @param {?object}       [o.calibration]         the Wave-9 calibrationVerdict (ρ̂ + learned-quorum state)
124  * @param {string[]}      [o.substrateFamilies]   the model families actually reachable this run
125  * @param {?string}       [o.northStar]
126  * @returns {object} the deliverable value
127  */
128 export function assembleDeliverable({
129   mode,
130   rounds = [],
131   convergence = null,
132   calibration = null,
133   substrateFamilies = [],
134   northStar = null,
135 } = {}) {
136   if (!MODES.includes(mode)) {
137     throw new HaltError(`assembleDeliverable: mode must be one of ${MODES.join(' | ')}, got ${JSON.stringify(mode)}`);
138   }
139   const cross_model = crossModelFor(mode, substrateFamilies);
140   const base = {
141     mode,
142     north_star: northStar ?? null,
143     cross_model,
144     // ρ̂ + learned-quorum state — carried in BOTH modes (default-mode calibration is pure-of-inputs).
145     calibration: calibration ?? null,
146     rho_hat: calibration?.rho_hat ?? null,
147   };
148 
149   if (mode !== 'engine') {
150     // Non-engine / prose / degraded: the adversarial loop did NOT run on this host. Say so, honestly.
151     return {
152       ...base,
153       verified: false,
154       honesty_stamp: HONESTY_STAMP,
155       round_history: [],
156       judge_verdict: null,
157       convergence_proof: null,
158       synthesizer_brief: null,
159     };
160   }
161 
162   // Engine mode: the full, adversarially-verified deliverable.
163   const finalRound = rounds.length ? rounds[rounds.length - 1] : null;
164   return {
165     ...base,
166     verified: true,
167     honesty_stamp: null,
168     round_history: deriveRoundHistory(rounds),
169     judge_verdict: engineJudgeVerdict(finalRound),
170     convergence_proof: convergence ?? null,
171     synthesizer_brief: buildSynthesizerBrief(rounds),
172   };
173 }
174 
175 /**
176  * The engine deliverable's judge section. P0 2026-07-25: a GOVERNED run may legitimately
177  * have no Judge verdict — the stakes governor excludes the Judge below the adjudication
178  * floor (crit-2), and the inclusion test skips zero-AXIS rounds entirely (crit-4). Those
179  * are HONEST absences and must be CARRIED as explicit exclusion stamps, not null — so the
180  * output-conformance gate still catches a verdict that is missing for any OTHER reason
181  * (a judge that should have run and didn't stays a contract violation).
182  */
183 function engineJudgeVerdict(finalRound) {
184   const jv = finalRound?.judgeVerdict;
185   if (jv != null) return jv;
186   if (finalRound?.skipped === true) {
187     return {
188       excluded: true,
189       by: 'inclusion-test',
190       reason: finalRound.reason ?? 'zero-AXIS-finding round skipped (crit-4) — no adjudication ran',
191     };
192   }
193   if (finalRound?.policy && finalRound.policy.judge === false) {
194     return {
195       excluded: true,
196       by: 'stakes-governor',
197       tier: finalRound.tier ?? null,
198       reason: finalRound.policy.reason ?? 'governor tier below the adjudication floor — Judge excluded (crit-2)',
199     };
200   }
201   return null; // genuinely missing — the conformance gate rejects this, by design
202 }
203 
204 // ── USER SURFACES — researchPrime's three summary levels (pure projections of the deliverable) ────────
205 function fmtConvergence(c) {
206   if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return 'convergence: (none recorded)';
207   return `convergence: ${c.converged ? 'CONVERGED' : 'not converged'} ` +
208     `(dryStreak=${c.dryStreak ?? '?'}, counted=${c.countedRounds ?? '?'}, rounds=${c.rounds ?? '?'})`;
209 }
210 
211 function fmtCalibration(d) {
212   const c = d.calibration;
213   if (!c) return 'ρ̂: (calibration not carried)';
214   const rho = c.rho_hat == null ? 'unestimated' : String(c.rho_hat);
215   return `ρ̂: ${rho} · learned-quorum required=${c.required ?? '?'} ` +
216     `(static would require ${c.static_would_require ?? '?'}) · ${c.stamp ?? c.mode ?? ''}`.trim();
217 }
218 
219 /**
220  * Render ONE user-facing summary surface (a string) for a deliverable. The three levels mirror
221  * researchPrime's full / executive / agent-implementation tiers. A NON-ENGINE deliverable's surfaces
222  * lead with the honesty stamp and NEVER use the forbidden "parity" claim (the conformance gate enforces
223  * this); an engine deliverable's surfaces report the verified result.
224  *
225  * @param {object} deliverable  the value from assembleDeliverable
226  * @param {'full'|'executive'|'agent-implementation'} level
227  * @returns {string}
228  */
229 export function renderSurface(deliverable, level) {
230   if (!SUMMARY_LEVELS.includes(level)) {
231     throw new HaltError(`renderSurface: level must be one of ${SUMMARY_LEVELS.join(' | ')}, got ${JSON.stringify(level)}`);
232   }
233   if (!deliverable || typeof deliverable !== 'object' || !MODES.includes(deliverable.mode)) {
234     throw new HaltError('renderSurface requires a deliverable from assembleDeliverable');
235   }
236   const ns = deliverable.north_star ? `North Star: ${deliverable.north_star}` : 'North Star: (unset)';
237 
238   if (deliverable.mode !== 'engine') {
239     // Prose / degraded mode. HONEST: leads with the stamp; makes NO equivalence/"parity" claim.
240     const stamp = `Honesty: ${deliverable.honesty_stamp}`;
241     const xm = `cross_model: ${deliverable.cross_model}`;
242     if (level === 'executive') {
243       return [`researchPrime (DEGRADED prose mode) — UNVERIFIED.`, stamp, xm].join('\n');
244     }
245     if (level === 'agent-implementation') {
246       return [
247         `# researchPrime deliverable [mode=degraded verified=false]`,
248         stamp,
249         xm,
250         fmtCalibration(deliverable),
251         `findings are SCHEMA-CONFORMANT prose only — re-run on an engine host for adversarial verification.`,
252       ].join('\n');
253     }
254     // full
255     return [
256       `# researchPrime Deliverable — DEGRADED (prose) mode`,
257       stamp,
258       xm,
259       ns,
260       ``,
261       `This host could not run the adversarial verification loop (G1–G9). The output below conforms to`,
262       `the deliverable SCHEMA only: there is NO Judge verdict, NO convergence proof, and NO round`,
263       `history. Treat every finding as UNVERIFIED prose — it has not been independently checked. To`,
264       `obtain a verified result, re-run on an engine host.`,
265       fmtCalibration(deliverable),
266     ].join('\n');
267   }
268 
269   // Engine mode: the verified surfaces.
270   const j = deliverable.judge_verdict;
271   const jline = `Judge verdict: ${j ? (j.verdict ?? j.decision ?? JSON.stringify(j)) : '(none)'}`;
272   const rounds = `rounds: ${deliverable.round_history.length}`;
273   if (level === 'executive') {
274     return [`researchPrime (engine, VERIFIED).`, jline, fmtConvergence(deliverable.convergence_proof)].join('\n');
275   }
276   if (level === 'agent-implementation') {
277     return [
278       `# researchPrime deliverable [mode=engine verified=true]`,
279       `cross_model: ${deliverable.cross_model}`,
280       jline,
281       rounds,
282       fmtConvergence(deliverable.convergence_proof),
283       fmtCalibration(deliverable),
284       `synthesizer_brief: present (decides=${deliverable.synthesizer_brief?.decides}) — steering only.`,
285     ].join('\n');
286   }
287   // full
288   return [
289     `# researchPrime Deliverable — ENGINE (adversarially verified)`,
290     ns,
291     `cross_model: ${deliverable.cross_model}`,
292     jline,
293     rounds,
294     fmtConvergence(deliverable.convergence_proof),
295     fmtCalibration(deliverable),
296     ``,
297     `Round history and the separate Synthesizer Brief (steering only — the Judge decides) accompany`,
298     `this report as structured sections.`,
299   ].join('\n');
300 }
301 
302 /** Render all three summary-level surfaces of a deliverable as `{ level: text }`. */
303 export function renderAllSurfaces(deliverable) {
304   return Object.fromEntries(SUMMARY_LEVELS.map((l) => [l, renderSurface(deliverable, l)]));
305 }
306 
307 // ── The OUTPUT-CONFORMANCE gate (the predicate test/output-conformance.test.mjs asserts on) ──────────
308 /** Does `text` use the forbidden prose word as a whole word (case-insensitive)? */
309 export function containsForbiddenProse(text) {
310   return new RegExp(`\\b${FORBIDDEN_PROSE_WORD}\\b`, 'i').test(String(text ?? ''));
311 }
312 
313 /**
314  * Check a deliverable against the Wave-10 output contract, returning `{ ok, violations }`.
315  *
316  * NON-ENGINE (prose) mode: must carry the literal honesty stamp, force `cross_model:false` (I3), and
317  * NO user surface may contain the forbidden "parity" claim.
318  * ENGINE mode: must carry every required section — round history, Judge verdict, convergence proof, the
319  * calibration (ρ̂ + learned-quorum) state, and the Synthesizer Brief — and the Brief must be SEPARATE
320  * from the Judge verdict (it must NOT decide).
321  *
322  * @returns {{ ok:boolean, violations:string[] }}
323  */
324 export function checkOutputConformance(deliverable) {
325   const violations = [];
326   if (!deliverable || typeof deliverable !== 'object' || !MODES.includes(deliverable.mode)) {
327     return { ok: false, violations: ['not a deliverable (missing/invalid mode)'] };
328   }
329   const surfaces = renderAllSurfaces(deliverable);
330 
331   if (deliverable.mode !== 'engine') {
332     if (deliverable.honesty_stamp !== HONESTY_STAMP) {
333       violations.push('non-engine deliverable must carry the exact honesty stamp');
334     }
335     if (deliverable.cross_model !== false) {
336       violations.push('non-engine deliverable must force cross_model:false (I3)');
337     }
338     for (const [level, text] of Object.entries(surfaces)) {
339       if (containsForbiddenProse(text)) {
340         violations.push(`prose-mode surface '${level}' claims "${FORBIDDEN_PROSE_WORD}" (forbidden)`);
341       }
342     }
343     return { ok: violations.length === 0, violations };
344   }
345 
346   // Engine mode: every section must be carried.
347   for (const k of ['round_history', 'judge_verdict', 'convergence_proof', 'calibration', 'synthesizer_brief']) {
348     if (deliverable[k] == null) violations.push(`engine deliverable missing required section: ${k}`);
349   }
350   if (deliverable.synthesizer_brief && deliverable.synthesizer_brief.decides !== false) {
351     violations.push('Synthesizer Brief must be SEPARATE from the Judge verdict (decides must be false)');
352   }
353   return { ok: violations.length === 0, violations };
354 }
355 
356 // Re-export the two-mode taxonomy so a consumer/test reads the SAME modes the evidenced core locks.
357 export { MODES };
